description: This source file defines the internal class AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory within the Orleans.Streaming.AdoNet namespace. It implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface and provides functionality to create and manage queue adapters for ADO.NET-based streaming in Orleans, including query initialization, adapter creation, and failure handling.
